project_name: Prevent & Restore Physical Therapy Admin CMS

headings.font_family: Blair ITC Std, Outfit, Montserrat, Cinzel, sans-serif

body.labels: font-['Futura_PT',Jost,Inter,sans-serif] text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

sidebar.container: w-64 bg-[#001D39] text-white flex flex-col min-h-screen border-r border-[#002B54]
sidebar.brand_header: p-6 border-b border-[#002B54] flex items-center gap-3
sidebar.nav_item_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-[#007791] text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors
sidebar.nav_item_inactive: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:bg-[#0094B2]/20 hover:text-white transition-colors

header.container: h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-xs
header.user_profile: flex items-center gap-3 border-l border-slate-200 pl-4

layout_and_navigation.main_content: flex-1 bg-slate-50 p-6 sm:p-8 min-h-screen overflow-y-auto

summary_cards.grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8
summary_cards.card: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:border-[#007791]/40 transition-all flex items-center justify-between
summary_cards.metric_title: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-1
summary_cards.metric_badge: text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-[#007791]

content_tables.wrapper: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
content_tables.header_controls: p-5 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-50/50
content_tables.th: px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-100/70 border-b border-slate-200
content_tables.td: px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-700 border-b border-slate-100 align-middle

block_editor.seo_sidebar: lg:col-span-1 bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-5 h-fit sticky top-20
block_editor.block_item: bg-white p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-xs relative group hover:border-[#007791]/50 transition-all
block_editor.block_actions: flex items-center gap-2 opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity

buttons.primary: px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#007791] hover:bg-[#0094B2] text-white font-medium text-sm transition-colors shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007791]/50
buttons.secondary: px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-[#001D39] font-medium text-sm transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-300
buttons.danger: px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-medium text-sm transition-colors shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500/50
buttons.ghost: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-[#001D39] text-sm transition-colors

inputs.text: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-800 text-sm focus:border-[#007791] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007791]/20 outline-none transition-all
inputs.select: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-800 text-sm focus:border-[#007791] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007791]/20 outline-none transition-all
inputs.textarea: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-800 text-sm focus:border-[#007791] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007791]/20 outline-none transition-all min-h-[100px]

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Next.js App Router JS, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, and Lucide react icons.
Implement persistent sidebar navigation containing all 10 required routes (Dashboard, Blogs, Services, What We Treat, Pages, Categories, Tags, URL Redirects, Settings, Logout).
Ensure total, published, and draft counts are displayed prominently on the Dashboard summary cards.
Ensure drag-and-drop handles are visually available in table listings and block editor items.
Every interactive element MUST have a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='btn-publish-blog'`).
Adhere strictly to primary teal `#007791` and navy blue `#001D39` branding provided.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain browser inputs without Tailwind focus rings.
Use precise APCA contrast for buttons and text elements over light and dark backgrounds.
All modals, dropdowns, inputs, and tab triggers must contain explicit data-testid values.
Avoid default placeholder images; use the curated unsplash/pexels URLs supplied in design_guidelines.json.
